title.ko: have/get + 목적어 + p.p. · make/let/get + 사람 + 동사
title.en: have/get + object + past participle · make/let/get + person + verb

explain.ko: 사역 구조는 누군가에게 일을 시키거나 서비스를 받을 때 씁니다. have/get + 목적어 + 과거분사는 ‘남에게 ~을 받다’라는 뜻입니다(I had my computer repaired). get이 have보다 구어체입니다. make + 사람 + 동사원형은 강제나 원인을(The film made me cry), let + 사람 + 동사원형은 허락을(My parents let me stay out late) 나타냅니다. get + 사람 + to + 동사원형은 설득해서 하게 하는 것입니다(She got me to go with her). 수동태인 be made to + 동사원형도 알아 두세요.
explain.en: Causative structures say that someone did something for you or that someone caused an action. Have/get + object + past participle means 'to have a service done' (I had my computer repaired); get is more informal. Make + person + base verb shows force or cause (The film made me cry); let + person + base verb shows permission (My parents let me stay out late); get + person + to + base verb shows persuasion (She got me to go with her). In the passive, make takes to: He was made to apologise.

notes.ko: get something done은 ‘직접 해냈다’는 뜻도 있습니다. I got the report finished.
notes.en: Get something done can also mean you managed to do it yourself.

task.model: Last week I had my laptop repaired. The service centre inspected and fixed it in one day. My parents made me leave it to the experts rather than fix it myself. So I'll do the same next time.

model_trans.en: Last week I had my laptop repaired. The service centre inspected and fixed it in one day. My parents made me leave it to the experts rather than fix it myself. So I'll do the same next time.
